works.method: Engineered bacterial sensors embedded in textile substrates; wicking threads passively move reagents to keep the cells alive (no electronics), with sensing nodes patterned by digital embroidery.
works.method_zh: 把工程化细菌传感器嵌入纺织基材；以吸液纱线被动输送试剂维持细胞存活（不用电子元件），并用数码刺绣布置感测节点。

paper.title: Can textiles be alive? Exploring transitional materialities through microbial biosensors and textile fluidics

works.title: From Creativity to Sympoiesis: More-than-Human Creative AI
works.description: A site-oriented design inquiry that starts with a multispecies ethnography of a local ecology, turns its co-creation processes into fabulations, and uses them to critique human-centred notions of creativity built into creative-AI tools.
works.description_zh: 一项以场地为导向的设计探究：从对一处在地生态的多物种民族志开始，把其中的共同创造过程转化为虚构叙事，再以此批判创意 AI 工具中内置的以人为中心的创造力观念。
works.idea_en: Design creative AI for 'making-with' situated ecologies (sympoiesis) instead of amplifying individual human creativity.
works.idea_zh: 把创意 AI 设计为与在地生态“一起创作”（共生创作），而不是放大个人的人类创造力。
works.method: Multispecies ethnography, fabulation as materialised analysis, and an analytical tool contrasting human-centred and more-than-human-centred notions of creativity.
works.method_zh: 多物种民族志、作为物化分析的虚构叙事，以及对比以人为中心与超越人类为中心的创造力观念的分析工具。

paper.title: Shifting from Creativity to Sympoiesis: A Site-Oriented Design Inquiry of More-than-Human Creative AI

works.title: A Reflective Lab Journal for Biodesign
works.description: Proposes a reflective lab journal that merges the biologist's lab notebook with the designer's annotated portfolio, so biodesigners can record precise protocols alongside creative iterations and their care for the organisms they work with.
works.description_zh: 提出一种反思性的实验日志，把生物学家的实验记录本与设计师的注释作品集结合起来，让生物设计者既能记录精确的流程，也能记录创作迭代以及对所合作生物的照料。
works.idea_en: Documentation is a design tool: a hybrid journal can hold both lab accountability and more-than-human sensibilities.
works.idea_zh: 记录本身就是设计工具：一本混合式日志可以同时承载实验的可追溯性与超越人类的感受力。
works.method: Exploratory review of documentation formats (lab notebooks, annotated portfolios and others), leading to a proposal for a reflective journal.
works.method_zh: 对实验记录本、注释作品集等记录形式进行探索性梳理，并据此提出反思性日志的方案。

paper.title: A reflective lab journal for biodesign: Navigating more-than-human sensibilities and disciplinary tensions

works.title: The X_Heal Toolkit
works.description: A toolkit of vocabulary, taxonomy, annotation template and stickers that helps designers observe, describe and reinterpret how living materials such as fungal and bacterial composites heal themselves over time.
works.description_zh: 一套由词汇表、分类法、标注模板和贴纸组成的工具包，帮助设计者观察、描述并重新诠释真菌、细菌复合材料等活体材料如何随时间自我修复。
works.idea_en: Treat self-healing as an expressive interaction with its own rhythms and traces, not just a technical repair.
works.idea_zh: 把自我修复当作具有自身节律与痕迹的表现性交互，而不只是技术性的修补。
works.method: Toolkit structured by Matter, Space and Time (form, visual and tactile qualities; direction and speed), grounded in shape-changing interfaces and Living Artefacts research; evaluated in focus groups with biodesigners.
works.method_zh: 工具包按“物质、空间、时间”三个维度组织（形态、视觉与触觉特征；方向与速度），以形变界面和“活的人造物”研究为基础；通过与生物设计者的焦点小组进行评估。

paper.title: The X_Heal Toolkit: Navigating Temporal and Dynamic Self-Healing Processes in Living Materials

works.title: Embodied Vibrational Methodologies (I.N.S.E.C.T. Summer Camp)
works.description: At a summer camp in a Danish national park, participants each chose a plant or insect companion, built species profiles, studied how insects make vibrations, did listening and shapeshifting meditations and made vibrational probes.
works.description_zh: 在丹麦一座国家公园的夏令营中，参与者各自选择一种植物或昆虫作伴，制作物种档案，研究昆虫如何产生振动，进行聆听与“化身”冥想，并制作振动探针。
works.idea_en: Vibration, a channel shared by humans, plants and insects, can be an embodied way into insect communication.
works.idea_zh: 振动是人、植物和昆虫共享的通道，可以成为进入昆虫交流世界的具身途径。
works.method: Mapping Ecologies, Critical Making and Being/Becoming methods adapted to substrate-borne vibration; reflection on translating insect physiology into design.
works.method_zh: 把“生态制图”“批判性制作”“存在/生成”等方法应用于基质传导振动；反思如何把昆虫生理知识转译进设计。

paper.title: Embodied vibrational methodologies: Exploring Vibration from a Multispecies perspective in a co-created Summercamp

works.title: Breathing Beside the Leaf: Plant–Human Symbiotic Meditation
works.description: A meditation system that turns a living plant's real-time photosynthetic signals into a generative soundscape, so the plant's rhythm becomes the cue that guides a person's breathing.
works.description_zh: 一个冥想系统，把活体植物的实时光合作用信号转化为生成式声景，让植物的节律成为引导人呼吸的提示。
works.idea_en: Let a living plant, left in its natural state, set the pace of human calm.
works.idea_zh: 让一株保持自然状态的活植物，为人的平静定下节奏。
works.method: Photosynthesis sensing (likely chlorophyll fluorescence or gas exchange) mapped to generative sound; experimental study with physiological and qualitative measures.
works.method_zh: 感测光合作用（很可能是叶绿素荧光或气体交换）并映射为生成式声音；结合生理与定性指标进行实验研究。

paper.title: Breathing Beside the Leaf That Guides Us: An Experimental Study on a Plant-Human Symbiotic Meditation System Design

works.title: The Bread Without Form
works.description: A practice-led study of the first author's sourdough bakery, where the ever-changing form of bread made with a living culture of wild yeasts and bacteria is used to rethink form, making and the designer's role.
works.description_zh: 一项以第一作者的酸面包烘焙坊为对象的实践研究：用野生酵母和细菌组成的活菌群制作的面包形态总在变化，借此重新思考形式、制作与设计者的角色。
works.idea_en: Form can be relational and emergent; baking with a living culture models design as convivial attunement, not domestication.
works.idea_zh: 形式可以是关系性的、涌现的；与活菌群一起烘焙，示范了设计是共生的调谐而非驯化。
works.method: Practice-led research with documentation and reflection on everyday sourdough baking, framed by symbiotic conviviality.
works.method_zh: 以实践为导向的研究，记录并反思日常的酸面包烘焙，以“共生的欢宴性”为理论框架。

paper.title: The bread without form: Attuning to relational ways of making through convivial baking practice

works.title: Meandering as Praxis: Soil Trust, Hong Kong
works.description: A study of Soil Trust, a social enterprise in rural Hong Kong that reclaims organic waste to regenerate soil, theorising its slow, indirect and exploratory way of working as 'meandering' participatory design.
works.description_zh: 一项关于“土壤信托”（Soil Trust）的研究：这家位于香港乡郊的社会企业回收有机废物以再生土壤，研究把它缓慢、迂回、探索式的工作方式理论化为“蜿蜒”的参与式设计。
works.idea_en: Regenerating soil takes design that meanders: nimble, relational, unhurried and deliberately open-ended.
works.idea_zh: 再生土壤需要“蜿蜒”的设计：灵活、注重关系、不急于求成、刻意保持开放。
works.method: Narrative inquiry and abductive analysis of 80 site engagements and 60 interviews, framed by agential realism; yields four dynamics (nimble resistance, relational logic, temporal fluidity, intentional ambiguity).
works.method_zh: 以能动实在论为框架，对 80 次现场参与和 60 次访谈进行叙事探究与溯因分析，得出四种动态：灵活抵抗、关系逻辑、时间流动性与有意模糊。

paper.title: Meandering as Praxis: Participatory Designing in Entangled Coexistence

works.title: Relational Transitions: Designing About, With, For, As and On Nature
works.description: An essay arguing that ecological design begins with a preposition, and setting out five stances (designing about, with, for, as and on nature) as different ways of positioning oneself toward the living world.
works.description_zh: 一篇论文，认为生态设计始于一个介词，并提出五种立场——关于、与、为、作为、在自然之上设计——作为面对生命世界的不同自我定位方式。
works.idea_en: Check your preposition: 'about', 'with' and 'for' nature often keep distance; 'as' and 'on' open mutualism and situated engagement.
works.idea_zh: 检查你的介词：“关于”“与”“为”自然常常保持距离；“作为”与“在其上”则开启互利与在地的投入。
works.method: Conceptual analysis of design language grounded in speculative materialism; proposes 'relational fluency', the ability to notice and shift one's stance.
works.method_zh: 以思辨唯物主义为基础分析设计语言；提出“关系流畅度”，即察觉并转换自身立场的能力。

paper.title: Relational Transitions

works.title: Esquejes in Co-labour
works.description: A method of 'esquejes' (Spanish for plant cuttings): visual artefacts about Indigenous landscapes made together with the community of Caspana, Chile, which then take root in the community as displays, narrative guides and sources of pride.
works.description_zh: 一种“插枝”（西班牙语 esquejes）方法：与智利卡斯帕纳社区共同制作关于原住民地景的视觉作品，这些作品随后在社区中“生根”，成为展示品、叙事向导和自豪感的来源。
works.idea_en: Like a cutting, a research artefact can be handed over to grow on its own; letting go of authorship is part of the method.
works.idea_zh: 像插枝一样，研究作品可以交出去自行生长；放下作者身份本身就是方法的一部分。
works.method: Co-labour within pluriversal ontological design (Escobar), care and situated knowledge (Puig de la Bellacasa, Haraway); three cases presented as photo-essay collages.
works.method_zh: 在多元世界本体论设计（Escobar）以及照料与情境知识（Puig de la Bellacasa、Haraway）的框架中开展协作劳动；三个案例以照片拼贴随笔呈现。

paper.title: Esquejes in co-labour: pluriversal design and visual artefacts of Indigenous landscapes in Caspana, Chile
